label: preparing
what: A privately commissioned inn hospitality/"jubilee" bread delivery of 200 loaves, arranged by the innkeeper through the baker and freight. They coordinated delivery/storage in the great hall; the innkeeper said he would settle the baker's account. This was not disclosed in advance, and the stated jubilee purpose remains vague; no evidence indicates town funding or a genuinely planned townwide jubilee. The neighbour knew of the bread and relayed the innkeeper's wish to discuss the account, but there's no solid evidence the neighbour knowingly helped arrange it.
